note: First published schema of the audit bundle verification document (GV-2), generated from AuditVerifyOutput in cli/src/audit_contract.ts on release/v1.3.0. Nothing was published before it. The signature finding kinds, the signature statuses valid, invalid and missing, the result intact_signed and public_key_sha256 are declared so the schema does not change when signing lands; nothing produces them yet.

GV-2 slice 2. Additive, so schema_version stays 1: the schema now also admits AuditExportResult, the document `nexus audit export --json` prints when a bundle was written (result "exported", with bundle_dir, bundle_id, manifest_sha256, signed, redaction, at_rest, file_count, file_bytes, omitted, warnings). Every document valid under the first entry is still valid, and what `nexus audit verify` prints is unchanged. The error document (AuditVerifyError) is now also what a failed export prints; only its description changed. GV-2 slice 3 now produces the predeclared intact_signed and valid/invalid/missing signature states when a caller supplies an operator-held Ed25519 public key.
